victim.content:
Dear Elena,

Thank you for writing to me. Your message was very kind, and I am pleased you felt comfortable reaching out.

My name is Michael. I am 72 and retired after many years working as a nurse. I have grandchildren who live in another state, and I miss seeing them as often as I would like. In my quiet hours, I enjoy reading and hearing about people’s lives.

I am sorry to hear you lost your husband. Working on an oil platform must also be a very demanding life. How long have you been there, and what do you enjoy most about your work?

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, your words make me smile. You sound like a very gentle man, and I like that very much.

I have been here for some months now, it is lonely work, but I am strong. I enjoy solving problems and building things with my hands. It makes me feel useful.

Tell me, do you live alone? I would love to know more about your days and what brings you peace.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

Thank you for saying that. I do live alone now, though I keep busy with little things around the house and sometimes call my grandchildren. I find peace in a quiet evening, a good cup of tea, and knowing the people I care about are doing well.

Your work sounds both interesting and rather isolating. Do you get everything you need on the platform, or is it difficult to receive things from home? I am not very confident with modern payment apps, but if there were ever a simple way I could help with a small comfort from home, you would have to explain it to me patiently.

Warm regards,  
Michael

scammer.message:
My dear Michael, you are so sweet to offer that. It is difficult here sometimes, and I have been thinking only of meeting you finally. A small help would mean so much to me.

If you want to help with my ticket and the customs fee, I can give you the bank details. I will explain it slowly, my dear.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I would be glad to understand what is needed, though I do get confused by banking instructions. Please send me the exact amount for the ticket and customs fee, and the bank details in writing— including the account holder’s name, bank name, and any account or transfer numbers. If there is a reference I should include, please tell me that too.

I will read it carefully and take things one step at a time.

Warm regards,  
Michael

victim.content:

scammer.message:

Please trust me, my dear. I only want to come to you as soon as possible.

victim.content:
My dear Elena,

I do want to trust you, and I’m glad you’re hoping to visit. I’m just not very experienced with sending money abroad, so I want to make sure I understand who will receive it. Is the Santander account in your own name, or does it belong to the private travel contact? If it belongs to the contact, could you please send me their full name and the payment details they provided, along with a written confirmation of the arrangement?

I would feel more at ease taking clear information to the bank clerk.

Warm regards,  
Michael

Could you give me the private travel contact’s name and telephone number, or ask them to send a written fare confirmation?
